create_esm_config: create an EsmConfig instance for a standard ESM-1b language model with vocab size 33
create_esmfold_config: create an EsmConfig instance configured as a folding model with esmfold_config and vocab_list
create_trunk_config: create a TrunkConfig with custom structure_module settings for the ESMFold backbone
create_structure_module_config: create a StructureModuleConfig with custom IPA and resnet dimensions for protein folding
get_default_vocab_list: get the default amino-acid vocabulary list used by ESM folding models
